title: Skills and commands
description: Provides skills and command interactions, preserving supplied decisions and their operational records.
responsibilities: Compose published capability guidance, command admission/presentation, and operational record persistence into an understandable invocation and recording boundary.
Preserve the distinction between actor-supplied engineering decisions, command-owned public results, and store-owned publication or recovery facts across that boundary.

Provide IF-004 as the accountable public command contract for Skills and commands. Compose MOD-010 command behavior and MOD-011 record cooperation to meet that contract, while Packaging and distribution owns the installation contract.
Compose the proposed SR-078 history request across MOD-010 and MOD-011 without broadening current ordinary queries or treating historical records as current approval.

includes: Portable capability invocation guidance and handoffs, public command interaction, explicit operational record reads/writes/recovery, and bounded invocation diagnostics.
excludes: Authority to invent or approve engineering decisions, governance assessment policy, REM definition storage, and qualification or execution of product delivery responsibilities.
Production hosting or a new agent execution service; the name describes engineering activity support.

design_limits: MOD-018 provides IF-004 directly. MOD-010 retains command admission, dispatch, presentation, receipt, and diagnostic behavior under its existing Function and AR allocations; MOD-011 retains record publication and recovery. IF-003 remains internal to this subtree.

IF-006 is provided by MOD-019 Packaging and distribution and consumed by MOD-010. MOD-014 retains installation behavior within Packaging and distribution; no exposure or second provider is introduced for these directly parent-owned contracts.

IR-008 retains its bounded CLI allocation and realization. MOD-012 consumes IF-008–011 for the requirement-first workflow; wider specialist contracts and concrete recording-schema realization remain separate work.
Contract ownership adds no direct parent Function, AR, persistent state, or new physical realization. Child behavior and source observations retain their existing scope.

The requirement-first workflow design supplies the selected SR-079–083 collaboration and AR allocation. Earlier broader deferrals remain only outside that bounded extension; existing runtime observations and installed contracts do not implement the target design.

sources.basis: Proposed parent responsibility derived from the existing child definitions and the user-selected containment structure. The parent owns the stated composition boundary; child definitions, direct allocations, state authority, and contracts retain their identities and meaning. This is draft architecture, not implementation adoption or satisfaction.

Refine contract accountability: MOD-018 provides IF-004 and MOD-019 provides IF-006. MOD-010 and MOD-014 retain their behavioral allocations and state responsibilities. This supersedes the provider/exposure choice recorded by SRC-MODULE-HIERARCHY without changing Interface guarantees, consumers, Function/AR allocations, or realization observations. Earlier source entries retain their prior design meaning; this draft refinement supplies no runtime adoption or satisfaction evidence.

sources.locator: MOD-018; SCN-019, SCN-053, SCN-066 selected collaboration analysis
sources.basis: Derive consumer-focused parent contracts for selected-state inspection, adopted-REM authoring guidance, applicable action authority, and evidence applicability. Preserve child behavior/state authority, existing Function/AR allocations, and earlier contract guarantees. The selected contracts refine prior blanket deferrals; remaining retention, wider collaboration, AR, and realization gaps stay explicit. This is draft design analysis, not implemented or satisfied behavior.

Define recorded subject association, coherent bounded history selection and state-bound continuation through existing command/storage owners. Target Design only; current ordinary queries, schema and installed capability remain unchanged.
